Prints QUIC close event details from trace fragments.

# Purpose
This file implements a QUIC trace log tile that reads one incoming fragment, copies the fragment payload into a local trace context, and prints a formatted record for QUIC connection close events. The [`before_frag`](<#before_frag>) callback filters fragments so the tile skips `FD_QUIC_EVENT_CONN_QUIC_CLOSE` events, [`during_frag`](<#during_frag>) copies the fragment data into `ctx->buffer`, and [`after_frag`](<#after_frag>) interprets that buffer as `fd_quic_log_error_t` and writes the close event fields to standard output with `printf`.

The file also defines a small `stem`-based execution wrapper in [`fd_quic_trace_log_tile`](<#fd_quic_trace_log_tile>). That function builds the input tables, creates the sequence and random state objects needed by `stem_run1`, allocates scratch memory, and runs the tile with one input and no outputs or consumers. The code uses `fd_stem.c` to connect the callbacks to the `stem` runtime, so this file acts as a narrow adapter between QUIC trace fragments and human-readable log output.
